owner_feedback_on_reference.retain: Stress on straight and never and word-to-mouth flow match very well.
owner_feedback_on_reference.change: Too expressive; mouth opens too widely.

motion_prompt: Speak with compact, natural mouth shapes and minimal jaw opening. Preserve clear consonants and the spoken emphasis on straight and never through subtle lip movement. Keep eyebrows relaxed, the head and shoulders nearly still, and eye contact steady.
selective_jaw_control: No documented separate control found; natural-language prompt is an experiment.
title: EP007 — Test C — Avatar IV compact mouth

visual_review.method: Sampled frames at 0,1,2,3,4,5 seconds compared against B; full-frame SSIM and PSNR comparison also performed after concern about repeated motion.
visual_review.observation: The sampled mouth opening, brow movement and head poses appear very close to B. No clear reduction demonstrated. A's same-time samples show smaller mouth openings.
visual_review.limits: Full-frame similarity includes the static background and does not quantify jaw amplitude. Still-frame sampling cannot pass moving-picture lip sync or visual emphasis. The new prompt was verified in the pre-submit UI; whether/how the provider used it is not established.

next_review: Compare delayed R2 Avatar V test A for lower movement while judging whether it retains the emphasis and word flow the owner liked in B. Do not infer a pass or submit more IV prompt retries without new evidence.
